title: Fleet Commander
kicker: From the bridge of a wedge destroyer
goal: You command a destroyer and its wings of fighters. Call plays, pick their stance and formation, trade broadsides with Rim ships, and burn the base on the world below.
playSub: One destroyer, six wings, a Rim base
campaignSub: A sector of worlds: mines, bases, lanes
computer: Computer: 1-6 pick a wing, F the flagship, G the interdictor. Click a Rim ship to mark it, right-click to order. Q-Y call plays, A/S/D stance, Z/X/C formation, B broadside, V rake the world, Space foresight, M trance. Drag or arrows to pan, wheel to zoom.
phone: Phone: tap a card to pick it, tap a Rim ship to mark it, then tap a play. Drag to pan, pinch to zoom.
